verdict.rationale: v0 supports iterative prompting via live preview, visual fine-tuning, and isolated GitHub branches/preview deployments that let founders test changes before they hit production, plus auto-fix for build errors — all mechanisms that reduce risk of follow-up prompts breaking things. However, there's no explicit evidence of regression protection, versioning/rollback of chat-based edits, or documentation addressing how v0 avoids overwriting working functionality during iterative prompting. Missing for 10: explicit rollback/undo across chat iterations, regression-safety guarantees, and independent hands-on evidence that follow-up prompts preserve prior working features.
